notes.title: August update
notes.content: [h3]Additions:[/h3][p][/p][p]Added new handicaps and skills[/p][p]Added music[/p][p]Added wild animals[/p][p]Added harvestable wild plants[/p][p]Added agility implants[/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes:[/h3][p][/p][p]Performance improvements[/p][p]Some clone behavior improvements[/p][p]Fixed issue with damage not being calculated correctly[/p][p]Effects now clear when enemies respawn[/p][p]Landmines now explode when shot[/p][p]Fixed a bug where Nexus was not finishing construction properly[/p][p]Fixed some more instances where clones would get stuck[/p][p]Fixed nitrogen pump audio not stopping when no power[/p][p]Game now keeps the custom resolution settings consistently[/p][p]Fixed a bug where a silhouette of an enemy would continue to burn[/p][p]Game now saves landmines and state of switched (on/off) objects[/p][p]Streamer laser now hits where the crosshair dot is pointing[/p][p]Increased flashlight brightness[/p][p]Enemy missile mechs do not destroy themselves while firing anymore, armor and HP bumped[/p]

tags.bug: Fixed issue with damage not being calculated correctly
Effects now clear when enemies respawn
Fixed a bug where Nexus was not finishing construction properly
Fixed some more instances where clones would get stuck
Fixed nitrogen pump audio not stopping when no power
Game now keeps the custom resolution settings consistently
Fixed a bug where a silhouette of an enemy would continue to burn
Game now saves landmines and state of switched (on/off) objects
Streamer laser now hits where the crosshair dot is pointing

tags.balance_change: Enemy missile mechs do not destroy themselves while firing anymore, armor and HP bumped

notes.title: Save system and more
notes.content: [h2]Additions:[/h2][p][/p][p]Added game saving and loading[/p][p]Added tutorial[/p][p]Added destructible trees[/p][p]Added armor, shield and implant[/p][p]Game length is now defined by number of waves instead of days[/p][p]Added instigator building (call waves early)[/p][p]Added stamina and oxygen meters[/p][p]Added wave info UI[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes: [/h2][p][/p][p]Fixed some situations where clones would get stuck[/p][p]Fixed a bug that caused weapons to stop working after the Streamer was unequipped[/p][p]Fixed some instances where certain audio loops would not stop[/p][p]Fixed some path-finding issues[/p][p]Fixed a lot of things I forgot to write down[/p][p]Fixed object pooler issue that was causing excess lag[/p][p]Fixed bug that made bullet casings stop being removed[/p][p]Fixed placement of farms[/p][p]Fixed weather audio volume control [/p]

tags.feature: Game length is now defined by number of waves instead of days

tags.bug: Fixed some situations where clones would get stuck
Fixed a bug that caused weapons to stop working after the Streamer was unequipped
Fixed some instances where certain audio loops would not stop
Fixed a lot of things I forgot to write down
Fixed object pooler issue that was causing excess lag
Fixed bug that made bullet casings stop being removed
